performance_case.causal_mechanism: A stale Local task, schema or fixed-root binding can make the active-chain gate report green while the deployed V3R1 exporter publishes an immutable package that no authorized Local runner can consume.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This audit may prove one exact static contract mismatch and freeze one bounded versioned cutover plan. It cannot prove the cutover implementation, transfer success, 14-day evidence completion, predictive value, fees, slippage, capacity, PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any later drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF because this capability audit only protects evidence delivery and does not evaluate a strategy mechanism.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One read-only Local audit costs a single bounded analysis cycle but can prevent the full fourteen-day forward collection from ending in an unusable handoff and avoids blindly expanding multiple stale downstream paths.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: An exact versioned chain contract reduces time-to-terminal-evidence and false-green risk so a completed V3R1 forward package can be interpreted once without identity drift; fee-adjusted equal-capital PnL remains unchanged and MISSING_PROOF.
